main_text.l: (ut nihil gravius dicatur) coalesceret, præsertim
cum nulla probabilis se prodiderit causa, cur in
hisce controversiis, quæ vos & vestra privilegia
non tangerent, nedum læderent, nobis adversa-
remini.
Sed Dei opus fuit admirabile in oculis nostris,
quod impedimenta ab adversariis nostris in toto hu-
jus negotii progressu objecta, totidem fuerint quasi
gradus quibus promoveretur: uti omnes bene no-
runt, & ingenue agnoscunt, quorum qualicunque
opera Deus hic usus est.
Porro ut testaremur tam fidelitatem ac animo-
rum nostrorum sinceritatem, erga famam sereniss.
nostri regis, (licet tum armati contra suos sub-
ditos,) quam amorem fraternum in nobiles &
alios vestræ gentis; (quibus nihil aliud proposi-
tum fuisse credimus, quam ut regem comitaren-
tur, licet revera sic satisfacerent ambitioni & cru-
delissimæ vindictæ miseri Præsulis) Æquissima &
humilia nostra postulata regi adhuc obtulimus,
prout tam piæ causæ defensores decuit; & in
tractatu pacificatorio omnem operam dedimus,
ut abunde satisfaceremus omnibus quæ requiri
possent à fidelibus subditis, quibus regis nostri ho-
nor cordi esset, idque non sine nostro probabi-
li incommodo, (adversariis etiam nostris judici-
bus) Nam regi sereniss. arces omnes munitas quas
voluit, tradidimus, in splendidissimum obedien-
tiæ nostræ testimonium, licet à nobis custodiri
potuissent, ut totidem arrhæ quibus certi redde-
remur præstitum iri articulos concessos, & con-
cludendos in subsequutura synodo & parlamen-
to: quæ tamen arces contra nostram spem con-
versæ sunt in catenas servitutis & terroris, ne arti-
culis in pacificatione stipulatis frueremur.

page.notes: The first word of the page is a continuation of the previous sentence and is kept as a fragment. The running head includes the printed year 1640; it is not a page number. The catchword "singulari" is kept out of the text. Long s is written as s throughout, so "præsertim" is printed with a long s. Some letters, such as the ligatures in "præ" and "Æquissima", are copied as printed and were read with confidence. The line-end hyphens in "adversa-remini" and "hu-jus" are printed hyphens and are kept.
